## API keys

Gluon takes a provider's key from the `.env` file next to the config (what `gluon setup` saved) or, failing that, from the environment. A launched agent gets only its model's provider key. Subscriptions use each agent's own login and need no variable.

| Variable | Provider | Used by | Create a key at |
|---|---|---|---|
| `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY` | Anthropic | Claude Code | https://console.anthropic.com/settings/keys |
| `OPENAI_API_KEY` | OpenAI | Codex | https://platform.openai.com/api-keys |
| `GEMINI_API_KEY` | Gemini API | Antigravity | https://aistudio.google.com/apikey |
| `XAI_API_KEY` | xAI | Grok Build | https://console.x.ai |
| `MOONSHOT_API_KEY` | Moonshot AI | Kimi Code | https://platform.moonshot.ai/console/api-keys |
| `OPENROUTER_API_KEY` | OpenRouter | Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, Kimi Code | https://openrouter.ai/settings/keys |

Amazon Bedrock takes no key: it uses your AWS profile and region (below).

## Config location

| Variable | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `GLUON_CONFIG` | Path of config.yaml (routing.yaml and the saved keys move with it); a relative path is made absolute from the directory Gluon starts in. |
| `XDG_CONFIG_HOME` | Moves the config directory: `$XDG_CONFIG_HOME/gluon/config.yaml`; a relative path is ignored, as the XDG spec says. On Windows the default is `%APPDATA%`. |

## Amazon Bedrock

Used when `bedrock.profile` or `bedrock.region` is unset in [config.yaml](config.md):

| Variable | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `AWS_PROFILE` | The AWS profile for Bedrock. |
| `AWS_REGION` | The region (wins over `AWS_DEFAULT_REGION`); when neither is set, the profile's `region` in your AWS config, else `us-east-1`. |
| `AWS_CONFIG_FILE` | Where Gluon reads the AWS config's `region` from, instead of `~/.aws/config` (that key only). |
| `AWS_DEFAULT_REGION` | The region, when `AWS_REGION` is not set. |

## Installer

Read from the header comments of `install.sh` (Linux, macOS) and `install.ps1` (Windows):

| Variable | install.sh | install.ps1 |
|---|---|---|
| `GLUON_ADD_TO_PATH` | n/a | 1: add the install directory to the user PATH (same as -AddToPath) |
| `GLUON_INSTALL_DIR` | where to install (default: ~/.local/bin) | where to install (default: %LOCALAPPDATA%\Programs\gluon) |
| `GLUON_RELEASE_URL` | where the release files are: an https:// base URL, a file:// URL or a local directory holding gluon-bun-&lt;os&gt;-&lt;arch&gt;[-musl] and SHA256SUMS. It wins over GLUON_VERSION. | where the release files are: an https:// base URL, a file:// URL or a local directory holding gluon-bun-windows-x64.exe and SHA256SUMS. It wins over GLUON_VERSION. |
| `GLUON_VERSION` | a version such as 1.0.0 (default: latest, the newest published GitHub release of fidipro/gluon) | a version such as 1.0.0 (default: latest, the newest published GitHub release of fidipro/gluon) |
